name: Immich-v3
description: Immich is a self-hosted backup solution for photos and videos. This installs the v3.0.0-rc.0 pre-release as a separate bare-metal instance alongside an existing v2 install, so the two can run side by side against the same media library.

notes.text: This installs Immich v3.0.0-rc.0, a pre-release. Expect breaking changes before the final v3.0.0 release, and do not rely on this instance as your primary photo library.

Runs alongside a separate v2 Immich instance using its own database, Redis and upload directory. To share an existing photo library read-only, mount it into this container and add it as an External Library from the Immich admin UI.

Enable Intel OpenVINO acceleration only if GPU passthrough is configured for this container. The installer applies a patch to machine-learning/immich_ml/sessions/ort.py to avoid an onnxruntime 1.24.1 OpenVINO device-enumeration segfault (immich-app/immich#23450, #25830).
